goal: A pure-Python double-entry bookkeeping library called ledgerline, standard library only, no network access anywhere. Exact API, one implementation module per task: src/ledger/money.py exposes parse_amount(text) -> int returning integer minor units and format_amount(minor_units) -> str, raising ValueError on malformed input. src/ledger/accounts.py exposes an AccountType enum of ASSET, LIABILITY, EQ
